clarifications.title: Income Below Spain DNV Threshold
clarifications.clarification: Spain DNV screening requires gross monthly income of at least EUR 2,800. Based on the amount provided, the application does not currently appear to meet that financial threshold.

clarifications.title: Income Amount Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: The monthly income amount was missing or could not be interpreted as a numeric EUR amount. The case should be reviewed before eligibility is confirmed.

clarifications.title: Work Relationship Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: The work relationship is missing or not recognized. The case should be reviewed before eligibility is confirmed because evidence requirements depend on whether the applicant is an employee, contractor, or business owner.

clarifications.title: Service Agreement Review Needed
clarifications.clarification: Self-employed applicants may need to show business-to-business work relationships through service agreements, contracts, or similar documentation. If those agreements cannot be secured, the case should be reviewed before eligibility is confirmed.

clarifications.title: Business Owner Work Structure Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: Spain's Digital Nomad Visa evaluates business owners as either a salaried employee of their business or a self-employed professional, depending on how they're paid. Whether this applicant is paid a salary or earns business/self-employment income is missing or unclear. The case should be reviewed before eligibility is confirmed.

clarifications.title: Employer Must Be Outside Spain
clarifications.clarification: Spain's Digital Nomad Visa requires employees to work for a company located outside Spain. Based on the information provided, the employer does not appear to meet this requirement.

clarifications.title: Employer Location Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: Whether the employer is located outside Spain is missing or unclear. The case should be reviewed before eligibility is confirmed.

clarifications.title: Employment Relationship Too Recent
clarifications.clarification: Spain's Digital Nomad Visa requires the employment relationship with the foreign employer to have existed for at least 3 months. The provided duration is below that minimum.

clarifications.title: Employment Duration Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: The length of the employment relationship with the foreign employer is missing or unclear. The case should be reviewed before eligibility is confirmed.

clarifications.title: Remote Work Not Approved
clarifications.clarification: Spain's Digital Nomad Visa requires that the employment relationship can be carried out remotely with the employer's approval. Based on the information provided, this does not appear to be the case.

clarifications.title: Remote Work Approval Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: Whether the employer approves remote work from Spain is missing or unclear. The case should be reviewed before eligibility is confirmed.

clarifications.title: Foreign Client Relationship Required
clarifications.clarification: Spain's Digital Nomad Visa requires self-employed applicants to have a professional relationship with at least one client or company located outside Spain. Based on the information provided, this does not appear to be the case.

clarifications.title: Foreign Client Relationship Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: Whether the applicant has a qualifying foreign client or company relationship is missing or unclear. The case should be reviewed before eligibility is confirmed.

clarifications.title: Client Relationship Too Recent
clarifications.clarification: Spain's Digital Nomad Visa requires the professional relationship with the foreign client or company to have existed for at least 3 months. The provided duration is below that minimum.

clarifications.title: Client Relationship Duration Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: The length of the professional relationship with the foreign client or company is missing or unclear. The case should be reviewed before eligibility is confirmed.

clarifications.title: Spanish Professional Activity Too High
clarifications.clarification: Spain permits self-employed applicants to perform up to 20% of their total professional activity for Spain-based clients or companies. Based on the percentage provided, the application exceeds that limit.

clarifications.title: Spanish Professional Activity Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: Whether any Spain-based professional activity is included, and what percentage it represents, is missing or unclear. The case should be reviewed before eligibility is confirmed.

clarifications.title: Company Operating History Too Short
clarifications.clarification: Spain's Digital Nomad Visa requires the company or group relied upon for the application to demonstrate real and continuous activity for at least 1 year. Based on the information provided, this does not appear to be the case.

clarifications.title: Company Operating History Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: Whether the company relied upon for the application has been operating for at least 1 year is missing or unclear. The case should be reviewed before eligibility is confirmed.

clarifications.title: Income Duration Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: The applicant should be able to document income history for the period needed to support the Spain DNV application. A short, missing, or unrecognized income-history answer should be reviewed before eligibility is confirmed.

clarifications.title: Income Evidence Incomplete
clarifications.clarification: The income evidence selected does not currently include the expected documents for the applicant's work type. The case should be reviewed to confirm whether alternative documents can support the application.

clarifications.title: Employee Income Evidence Incomplete
clarifications.clarification: Employee applicants should provide employee-specific salary evidence, such as bank statements, an employment contract, and pay stubs. If those documents are incomplete, the case should be reviewed to confirm whether alternative employee evidence can support eligibility.

clarifications.title: Contractor Income Evidence Incomplete
clarifications.clarification: Contractor or self-employed applicants should provide contractor-specific income evidence, such as bank statements, invoices, and service agreements or contracts. If those documents are incomplete, the case should be reviewed to confirm whether alternative contractor evidence can support eligibility.

clarifications.title: Business Owner Income Evidence Incomplete
clarifications.clarification: Business-owner applicants should provide business-specific income evidence, such as bank statements, business registration, and tax returns or financial statements. If those documents are incomplete, the case should be reviewed to confirm whether alternative business evidence can support eligibility.

clarifications.title: Dependent Count Missing
clarifications.clarification: The application should confirm whether the applicant is applying individually or with family dependents. Dependent count can affect income review and family eligibility.

clarifications.title: Passport Validity Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: The passport validity answer is missing or below the screening threshold. The applicant may need to renew the passport or confirm validity before eligibility is confirmed.

clarifications.title: Health Insurance Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: The applicant should have qualifying health insurance or be able to obtain it. If insurance status is unclear, the case should be reviewed.

clarifications.title: Police Clearance Unavailable
clarifications.clarification: The applicant may need to provide a criminal background certificate or police clearance. If this document cannot be obtained, the case should be reviewed before eligibility is confirmed.

clarifications.title: Criminal Background Needs Review
clarifications.clarification: A disclosed criminal record should be reviewed before eligibility is confirmed. The review should determine whether the record affects the Spain DNV application.

clarifications.title: Manual Review Required
clarifications.clarification: The information provided is not enough to confirm Spain DNV eligibility automatically. The case should be reviewed manually so the team can identify the appropriate next step.
